verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a Weave Service API reference with REST endpoints, but nothing shows it is interactive or offers runnable examples, such as a try-it console or executable snippets. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on all candidate paths. The Playground is for testing LLM prompts and models, not for exploring the API reference, so it does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
